chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:
There is no Jumuʿah except in a city in which the prescribed punishments are carried out.
So the interpretation of this report is taqiyyah, because it conforms to the doctrines of most of the ʿāmmah, and likewise.

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةُ: dissimulation for protection in circumstances requiring it
key_terms.الْوَجْهُ: the correct interpretive approach or explanation
key_terms.جُمُعَةَ: Jumuʿah prayer, the congregational Friday prayer
key_terms.مِصْرٍ: a city or established urban center

ai.seo_question: How is the hadith "لَا جُمُعَةَ إِلَّا فِي مِصْرٍ يُقَامُ فِيهِ الْحُدُودُ" understood in al-Istibṣār?
ai.summary: This report concerns the legal conditions of Jumuʿah and restricts it to a city where legal punishments are implemented. The compiler then states that the proper understanding of this report is taqiyyah, because it agrees with the positions of most of the ʿāmmah.
